findings.evidence:
The status message slot is an empty

with no role recorded in dom-1440.json; results of 'Create draft project' and 'Export' are written there visually.
findings.after: , and write failures with role="alert"
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.3 Status Messages: async results must be announced without moving focus.

findings.evidence: Busy and disabled states are shown only with opacity: 0.5 on a #1d4ed8 button with white text; this halves text contrast and the busy state has no text or aria-busy/aria-disabled change.
findings.after: Keep text contrast >= 4.5:1, change the label ('Creating...') and set aria-busy="true" or aria-disabled="true" on the button
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: state carried by appearance alone is not exposed.

findings.evidence: Plan headings are h3 directly under h1 'Projects' with no h2 for the plan group (sweep confirmed the h1>h3 jump); the group has no heading at all, so screen-reader heading navigation lists 'Starter', 'Team', 'Scale' as peers of 'Your projects' content.
findings.before: h1 > (h3 Starter, h3 Team, h3 Scale) > h2 Your projects
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels.

strengths: Every button has a visible 3px #1d4ed8 outline with 2px offset (focus/00-04 crops), well over 3:1 on white.
Focus order (Choose Starter, Choose Team, Choose Scale, Create draft project, Export) matches visual order; targets are 44px+; reflows cleanly at 375.
not_investigated: Keyboard and live-region behaviour after clicking buttons: no live testing run.
Whether ARIA attributes exist on #toast: dom capture does not record aria-* attributes.
Sweep skip-link hit (first focusable is 'Choose Starter'): agreed, low impact on a page this short.
